_note: OCA Anaphora hierarch-commemoration derivation. Produces 3 overlay keys from { primate_name, ruling_hierarch_name } form fields. Other litany keys (greatLitany / augmentedLitany / litya — Vespers and Liturgy) need a separate 'short form' field per hierarch and are derived in Phase 2; until then they cascade through legacy_overlay_path.

keys.anaphora-chrysostom.commemoration-hierar: Among the first, remember, O Lord, His Beatitude, the Most Blessed {primate_name}; and His Eminence, the Most Reverend {ruling_hierarch_name}. Grant them for Thy Holy Churches in peace, safety, honor, health, and length of days, rightly to divide the word of Thy truth.
